title: How to Build an E-Commerce Store With AI (No Code Required)
summary: Build a complete e-commerce store with AI — product listings, cart, checkout, payments, inventory, and order management. No code or Shopify subscription needed.
body_markdown: Stripe charges 2.9% + 30¢ per successful card transaction. Prompt Blink: "Integrate Stripe Checkout for payment processing. After payment, save the order to the database with status 'pending', send a confirmation email to the customer, and redirect to a success page." Blink generates the Stripe integration, handles webhook verification, and writes orders to your built-in database. When Blink asks, paste your live Stripe publishable and secret keys from your Stripe dashboard — Blink only accepts live keys, not test ones. Once connected, Blink can register the webhook endpoint and save the signing secret automatically. If you want to add subscriptions later, the[Stripe subscription guide](https://blink.new/blog/how-to-build-stripe-subscription-app) covers the recurring billing layer.
